title: This Berkeley artist was given six months to live. Now he’s asking us to rethink our relationship with water.
summary: A double-lung transplant reshaped Professor Greg Niemeyer’s understanding of water as circulation, inspiring his latest art installation, now on view at the Worth Ryder Art Gallery. The post This Berkeley artist was given six months to live. Now he’s asking us to rethink our relationship with water. appeared first on Berkeley News .
